questions.q: Why does a restaurant need digital marketing?
questions.a: Most guests now find, book and order from restaurants online, so being visible there helps you reach new people and stay top of mind with regulars. Digital channels also let you talk to guests directly and build a loyal following. Compared with offline ads, they're usually more cost-efficient and easier to measure.

questions.q: How do I start digital marketing for my restaurant?
questions.a: Begin with the basics: a mobile-friendly website with clear buttons to order or book, and a complete Google Business Profile. Then pick the social channels your guests actually use and post appealing photos and videos of your food and space. Build from there with reviews, email and SMS, and test what works for you.

questions.q: Which digital marketing channels work best for restaurants?
questions.a: Social media, Google Business Profile, online reviews, email and SMS are the core channels most restaurants use. Social media builds awareness, while your Google profile and reviews help nearby guests choose you. Email and SMS are useful for bringing past guests back with offers and news.

questions.q: Should my restaurant respond to online reviews?
questions.a: Yes, responding shows guests you value the time they took to share their experience, whether it was positive or negative. Thoughtful replies to criticism can also reassure people who read your reviews before deciding where to eat. Try to reply promptly and understand the context before you respond.

questions.q: Is influencer marketing worth it for restaurants?
questions.a: It can help you reach new audiences and raise visibility, especially in your local area. Many restaurants work with a mix of larger and smaller influencers rather than relying on one big name. Pair it with strong photos, local partnerships and a loyalty program so the new guests you attract come back.
